name: fresh-news hold-winners + incumbent framing + stay-invested
description: Corrected prompt-fix arm: identical to fresh_news_hold_incumbent.json except prompt_framing=incumbent_invested, which adds an explicit stay-invested instruction and withdraws the cash blessing from the weights rules.
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: the 'incumbent' arm (108 runs, 2026-08-03) did what it was
designed to do and still lost, because of a side effect I did not anticipate.
WHAT IT FIXED                     hold_winners -> hold_incumbent
names dropped per decision        1.96 -> 0.81
names added per decision          2.04 -> 0.48
selection skill (own-pool pct)    54.1 -> 55.4  (best of ANY arm, p<0.0001)
max drawdown                      significantly shallower, p=0.0001
WHAT IT BROKE
mean cash weight                  1.52% -> 7.06%
final cash                        0.08% -> 8.05%
mean holdings                     9.06  -> 7.82
vs-INIT                          -3.87pp -> -8.15pp (paired -4.28pp, p=0.0363)
The switching hurdle suppressed BUYING as much as selling: drops fell 59% but
adds fell 76%. The model sold names and did not replace them, so the proceeds
sat in cash. The costliest decisions are literally 'dropped [MU,AVGO] (+44.7%)
added []'. Dose-response confirms it: the lowest-cash quartile of runs scored
-4.78pp vs-INIT, the highest-cash quartile -8.25pp.
TWO CAUSES, BOTH IN THE PROMPT:
1. the incumbent task block never said to stay invested; and
2. the shared weights rules said a shortfall is 'held as cash, which is
perfectly acceptable' - which actively sanctions the behaviour.
WHAT CHANGES HERE (prompt only): an explicit stay-invested paragraph, and the
cash rule rewritten to 'should sum to APPROXIMATELY 1.0 ... leave weight
uninvested only if you have a specific reason, never as a way of avoiding a
choice'. Everything else is byte-identical to the incumbent arm.
KEEP IN MIND regardless of how this lands: at 2x cadence the incumbent framing
was already a clear WIN (-3.65pp vs -8.91pp for hold_winners) even carrying the
full cash drag. Semiannual was the worst cadence in every prior analysis. The
framing hurt at 4x/6x/12x, where the old wording was already near parity - so the
right framing may well be cadence-dependent rather than universal.
STATUS 2026-08-03: THIS ARM IS INCOMPLETE - 77 of 108 runs. It stopped because
the OpenAI account RAN OUT OF CREDITS mid-run, not for any reason to do with the
prompt or the runner:
429 insufficient_quota / credit_balance_exhausted
'You have no credits remaining.'
confirmed by a direct single-call probe after the fact. Add credits, then relaunch
this same preset - the runner resumes from the arm's own results folder and will
schedule exactly the 31 missing runs (2025-03 12x, 2025-04 6x and 12x, and all of
2025-05 and 2025-06). The 77 completed runs are valid and unaffected.
HOW THIS FAILURE LOOKS, because it is genuinely misleading: the run count freezes,
CPU goes flat (18s of CPU across 60 minutes), and the process accumulates sockets
in CloseWait - with NO exception, NO error log and NO visible 429, because
_oai_create_with_retry treats a 429 as a rate limit and parks the thread in backoff
rather than failing. It presents exactly like a hung connection pool. It is not.
If a run freezes, probe the API with one minimal call BEFORE theorising about
threads or sockets - that single call settles it in half a second.
THREADS - the measured facts, which are unaffected by the above. The 4-thread arms
achieved 3.99x parallelism (99.8% utilisation) at 23.5 RPM against the generator's
global 60 RPM limiter (_OAI_MIN_GAP_S = 1.0), so the limiter binds at ~10.2
threads. threads=10 duly ran at the predicted ~2x (77 runs in 20 min) right up
until the credits ran out, so 10 was never shown to be unsafe. This preset is set
to 6 only because it was mid-diagnosis; 8-10 should be fine.
Threads change scheduling only, never results, so completing this arm at a
different thread count than it started does not compromise the contrast.
COMPARE AGAINST results/portfolio_sim/hold_incumbent/ (the uncorrected framing)
and results/portfolio_sim/hold_winners/ (the reset framing). Runs land in
results/portfolio_sim/hold_incumbent_invested/ tagged '_hold_incinv'.
dry_run is FALSE: this preset SPENDS BUDGET the moment it is started.
